hero.copy: Connect your wallet. Query the chain. Sign on your device.
wallet.fileHelp: Select your .webd file. Its keys remain in this session.
connection.title: Mainnet connection
connection.help: URLs and credentials remain only in this session. The node must allow CORS.
connection.initial: Your balance will appear after querying a real node.
balance.title: On-chain balance
mining.title: Mining
mining.note: Argon2 PoW and locally signed PoS using Mainnet work.
transfer.title: Send WEBD
transfer.summary: Review what the recipient will receive.
receive.title: Your address
receive.copyHelp: Share this address to receive WEBD.
modules.title: Connected modules
modules.miningHelp: Mainnet PoW/PoS engine · Core fault isolation
activity.title: Session activity
security.label: ◇ LOCAL SIGNING
security.title: Your keys, yours alone.
security.copy: Ed25519 signing happens on your device. The private key is removed from memory when the wallet is locked.
offline.title: Offline payment
offline.copy: Carry a signed payment by QR or NFC. It settles when the chain accepts the transaction.
offline.info: The balance comes from an external node. This PWA does not verify consensus like a full node.
review.title: Confirm transfer
review.note: The fixed 10 WEBD protocol fee is shown before confirmation. Confirmation signs and broadcasts to the Mainnet node.
offline.dialogCopy: You need a recent balance and nonce query. The voucher does not reserve on-chain funds and may expire or conflict with another payment.
offline.payloadPlaceholder: Paste the voucher from the other instance
recovery.title: Save your phrase
recovery.copy: This 24-word phrase recovers the wallet in this PWA. Also export the .webd file for the official client.
errors.qrUnreadable: No readable QR code was found.
nfc.unsupported: NFC is unavailable on this device; use QR.
nfc.writeReady: Bring the phone close to an NFC tag.
nfc.readReady: Bring the phone close to the NFC tag.
wallet.networkError: The Mainnet network could not be queried.
errors.reviewBusy: Close the current review before preparing another operation.
theme.label: Theme
wallet.passwordPolicy: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
offline.doubleSpend: Single-use voucher; session nonce and expiry are checked.
offline.chainCheck: The chain is checked before acceptance when available.
offline.duplicate: This nonce or voucher was already used in this session.
network.readOnlyHelp: Read-only Mainnet mirror. A synchronized writable node is required to sign and broadcast.
network.restConnected: REST node connected; confirmed broadcast uses the node native Socket.IO transport.
network.polling: Mainnet connected through Engine.IO polling; signing and propagation remain local.
network.websocket: Mainnet connected through native WebSocket; signing and propagation remain local.
network.queryActive: Mainnet query is active; the propagation channel will reconnect if needed.
wallet.created: Wallet created. Save the phrase and export the .webd.
wallet.lockedToast: Wallet locked. Import it again to sign.
transaction.signing: Signing locally and connecting to the node…
transaction.failed: Broadcast failed: {error} You can retry this same operation when the node is available.
offline.signedToast: Voucher signed locally. Mainnet policy limits its claim.
offline.validToast: Signature and recipient verified. On-chain balance is unchanged.
offline.qrRead: QR read. Validate the voucher before claiming.
network.offlineToast: No internet. Showing the last query; vouchers remain unsettled.
network.onlineToast: Connection restored. You can review pending claims.
app.swFailed: Offline installation could not be activated.
